title: A note on uniform random covering problems in metric spaces
summary: In this paper, we study the uniform random covering problem in general metric space $(X,d)$. Let $ω=(ω_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ be a sequence of independent identically distributed random variables on $(X,μ)$, and $\ell=(\ell_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ a sequence of positive real numbers. We analyze the size of the set \[\mathcal{U}(ω,\ell)=\left\{y\in X\colon \forall N\gg1,~\exists 1\le n\le N,~s.t. ~d(ω_n,y)<\ell_N\right\},\] and establish the 0-1 law for the Hausdorff dimension of $\mathcal{U}(ω,\ell)$, its measure and the event $\mathcal{U}(ω,\ell)=X$.
